summary_1line: Draupadi laments to Bhima the humiliating disguises and suffering of the Pandavas during exile, especially Arjuna’s, while clinging to hope that fortune will turn.

image_candidates.scene_text: Draupadi speaks to Bhima in anguish, describing Arjuna in braided hair and earrings teaching dance among palace women.
Arjuna as Brihannala stands in a music hall surrounded by royal maidens, wearing ornaments and braids instead of armor.
Sahadeva sleeps on calf-skins beside cattle at night, a royal warrior reduced to a humble cowherd.
